channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: Contractor named to Digbeth apartments scheme featuring 34-storey tower
item.description: Latimer, the development arm of Clarion Housing Group, has signed a main works contractor for a £112m residential development in Digbeth, Birmingham.

item.title: Strong year M42 and Solihull office market - "the story of 2025 is steady recovery, with clear pockets of strength"
item.description: The M42 and Solihull office market has surged past the five-year average, according to the latest figures, with 2025 proving to be a "dependable year in what remains an unpredictable, post-pandemic market".

item.title: Acquisition to get model railway specialist back on track - "fresh energy and vision to take the business confidently into the future"
item.description: A North Yorkshire model railway specialist has been acquired in a deal that is set to bring "stability, new investment and a renewed structure".

item.title: Breedon Group completes major Cloud Hill quarry upgrade
item.description: Construction materials giant Breedon Group has completed an upgrade to its Cloud Hill quarry in Derbyshire following a £870,000 investment.

item.title: Wrights marks 100th anniversary with centenary bakes - supported by Great British Menu star
item.description: Staffordshire bakery brand Wrights is celebrating its 100th anniversary with the launch of limited edition products.

item.title: Food manufacturing recruitment agency relocates to Tileyard North
item.description: A specialist food manufacturing recruitment agency has relocated to a new base at Tileyard North in Wakefield.

item.title: Findel upgrades Netherfield fleet to support net zero goal
item.description: Educational resources supplier Findel has upgraded the fleet of forklift trucks at its distribution centre in Netherfield as part of its ongoing commitment to become net zero by 2040.

item.title: Food machinery business moves to historic Shropshire site - "places us at the very heart of Britain's industrial story"
item.description: A food machinery supplier has relocated to a historic site in Shropshire to support its growth in a move the company's managing director said places it "at the very heart of Britain's industrial story".

item.title: Vail Williams makes pair of building consultancy promotions in South East
item.description: Property consultancy Vail Williams has made two promotions in its building consultancy team.

item.title: Sunglasses retailer to focus on growth with IP-backed loan
item.description: A £22m-turnover online retailer of prescription glasses and designer sunglasses based in the North West has secured funding from NatWest to support its growth plans.
